title: Calibration Sweep Orchestrator: profile gating, artifact retention and access policy hub
creator: Evan Zhao
description: Build a Calibration Sweep Orchestrator in Redwood Console that coordinates FP8/INT8 sweep jobs, enforces a gating policy based on accuracy validation against golden prompt suites, manages artifact lifecycle (TTL tiers and archival), and exposes role-based access controls for run visibility and artifact downloads. Goal: make multi-profile calibration runs first-class, auditable, and safe to auto-apply to serving workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a 'Sweep' job workflow UI that can batch multiple quant profiles (FP8/INT8 variants) and schedule runs with target datasets
Each sweep run produces an immutable artifact bundle with metrics: per-prompt accuracy, token-level divergence, latency/throughput delta, and calibration metadata

A gating policy config is available that can automatically mark runs as PASS/FAIL based on configurable thresholds (accuracy delta, quality regression), and optionally auto-promote passing artifacts to a staging model bundle
Artifact retention policies implemented with three tiers (ephemeral 7d, short-term 90d, long-term archive 365d) configurable per-project and visible in run metadata
RBAC controls: 'calibration-run-reader', 'calibration-run-operator', 'calibration-run-owner' map to Console roles; audit events recorded for artifact download and promotion
APIs and SDK endpoints available for starting runs, fetching run status, and retrieving artifacts with signed URLs respecting permissions
End-to-end e2e tests for a sample FP8 and INT8 sweep covering metrics collection, gating logic, and TTL enforcement
comments: 2025-02-18 - Evan Zhao: Initial ticket created after design review; priority set to P0 due to enterprise requests for automated quantization workflows.
2025-02-20 - Maya Patel: Scoped feature set for MVP: sweep UI + gating + TTL; defer advanced lineage visualization to follow-up cycle.

2025-02-24 - Eng lead (R. Singh): Proposed implementation: orchestrator service will kick off calibration workers, persist artifacts to S3 bucket with per-tenant prefixes, and write metadata to runtime catalog. Need to validate cost impact of storing artifacts for long-term archive.
2025-02-27 - Security (A. Kim): Requested threat model and key management details for artifact downloads; recommend signed URLs with short TTL and KMS encryption for archive tier.
2025-03-01 - Design (L. Navarro): UX mocks uploaded; users need quick pass/fail ribbon in runs list and a compact diff view for golden prompts; will iterate on table density for large sweep results.
2025-03-03 - PM review: Decided NOT to auto-apply INT8 artifacts to production by default; require a manual promotion step or explicit opt-in in project settings.

2025-03-04 - Eng (R. Singh): GitHub PR opened for orchestration API and artifacts schema; initial unit tests added. Performance note: batching FP8 calibration across 4 GPUs reduced wall time by ~2.7x in perf test.

Implement gating DSL in config service and expose via Console policy editor
Ship RBAC mappings and audit event plumbing; coordinate with Security for signed URL/TLS requirements
